Stability (malady)Metatribers have spent their entire lives without a home. Every group they joined felt too narrow, and so eventually they moved to the periphery. Because of this, metatribers lack practice building stable community.
↓
1305580334122250241 [2020-09-14] @TylerAlterman 💜 17
Stability (antidote)1. Drop polyamory2. Start village with other metatribers3. Do events/residencies to find aligned long-term partner4. Have kids5. Move extended family to village6. Raise kids as a village#6 will make it possible to both have kids and pursue a career.
↓
1305580335032303617 [2020-09-14] @TylerAlterman 💜 6
Naturalness (malady)Malady: Metatribers are often former nerds and need more fluency in things like intuition, expression, social grace, romance, etc.
↓
1305580336005492741 [2020-09-14] @TylerAlterman 💜 9
Naturalness (antidote) Embed your village inside of a culture high in naturalness. eg Spain, Ireland, probably Sri Lanka. Get to know the mayor, help out your neighbors, get drunk with locals.
↓
1305580336848482310 [2020-09-14] @TylerAlterman 💜 13
Doing (malady)While the metatribe includes a number of world-class entrepreneurs, the majority of metatribe members aren’t great executors yet. They spend too much time talking about ideas instead of enacting them.
↓
1305580337901309952 [2020-09-14] @TylerAlterman 💜 13
